metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2026 · Emperor vs Sarat Chandra
metas.description: Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, loved for his humanist novels, finds himself at the center of a storm when he writes Pather Dabi—a fierytale of Sabyasachi, a revolutionary whose ideas electrify the youth.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · La bola negra
metas.description: Explores what it means to be gay throughout different eras, focusing on "three existences" that are connected through themes of sexuality, desire, pain, and inheritance.

metas.name: 2026 · The Uprising
metas.description: Based on the true story of the uprising that inspired the legend of Robin Hood, Andrew Garfield stars as the leader of a rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II in a fight for justice.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Turning Point: Generation 9/11
metas.description: Twenty-five years after 9/11, children of the attacks, journalists, young Afghans and Marines reveal how a generation came of age in the shadow of that day, and inherited a world shaped by the decisions and wars that followed.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · The Brink of War
metas.description: President Reagan races to save a nuclear deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev as pressure mounts all around him. Every word spoken could move the world closer to peace - or destruction.
